title: Custom Football Texture with Prominent Laces Vintage Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports-themed sanctuary with the Custom Vintage Football Art Comforter from Jeminise. This custom sports bedding is crafted to deliver exceptional comfort and cozy warmth, making it the perfect focal point for any football fan's room.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features an customizable layout where you can add your preferred name and number details for a truly unique sports bedding experience.
  • Cozy & Lightweight Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a soft, whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Versatile Bedroom Style: Beautifully printed with a photorealistic vintage football artwork design, perfect for football lovers, players, and fans.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit your bed perfectly.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Brushed Polyester
Selected Design Vintage Football Art
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
